about_the_game:
Leap, Conquer, and Push Your Limits in This High-Stakes Infinite Platformer!

Traverse treacherous landscapes, evade relentless enemies, and test your reflexes in this fast-paced infinite jumper. Whether you're a casual player or a seasoned platforming expert, this game offers endless action and challenge.

Master Unique Characters & Unlock Powerful Abilities

Choose from 10 distinct characters, each with their own abilities and playstyle. Uncover a secret character waiting to be discovered and push your high score even further. Adapt your strategy and find the perfect hero to dominate the leaderboards.

Conquer Ever-Changing Worlds

Explore 5 dynamically designed worlds, each packed with unique obstacles, enemies, and hazards. Every run presents a new challenge, ensuring no two playthroughs are ever the same.

Collect, Upgrade, and Rise to the Top

Gather coins as you progress, smash through enemies, and unlock exclusive rewards. Elevate your experience with new characters and abilities to refine your strategy and reach new heights.

Key Features:

✅ 10 Playable Characters – Each with distinct abilities, including a secret unlockable character.
✅ 5 Unique Infinite Levels – Diverse environments, unpredictable hazards, and escalating difficulty.
✅ Challenging Enemies & Obstacles – Test your reflexes with increasingly difficult platforming.

✅ Coin Starter Bonus – Downloading the game provides a free 450 coins to unlock an extra new character or level of your choice right off the bat.

How high can you climb? Prove your skills, set new records, and conquer the ultimate infinite platforming challenge!

Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 or later
  • Processor: Intel i3 2100 / AMD FX 6300
  • Memory: 1 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 650 (2 GB) / AMD R7 260X (2 GB)
  • DirectX: Version 10
